decisions.decision: Verify Proof drops the persistent Proof-ID store entirely. No database, no Proof-ID, no Verification URL.
decisions.rationale: User caught that persistent storage contradicts the existing single-use/5-min nonce anti-replay model. /verify is stateless crypto+on-chain check; proofs just stop verifying after their freshness window, no cleanup needed.

decisions.decision: Proof freshness window raised from 5 to 15 minutes.
decisions.rationale: A live two-phone QR round trip (issue challenge -> scan -> consent -> generate -> scan -> verify) needs more slack than the original company-automated 5-min nonce window.

decisions.decision: Verify Proof is a two-hop QR handshake: outgoing challenge QR (nonce from /session/nonce + requested fields) from verifier to prover, returning proof QR from prover to verifier. Both hops support scan-or-manual-entry.
decisions.rationale: Matches user's peer-to-peer 'student verifies another student' scenario; nonce must be backend-issued (not invented client-side) or anti-replay is meaningless.

decisions.decision: Consent is folded into the existing attribute-checklist screen, not a separate screen. Requested fields show pre-checked but editable; tapping 'Generate Proof' is the consent action.
decisions.rationale: User: consent should exist 'whenever the prover is starting to select their attributes' — avoid a redundant extra confirmation screen.

decisions.decision: Verify Proof folds back into Phase 8 — no separate Phase 8.1.
decisions.rationale: The only reason to split it off (needing a new persistent backend store) no longer applies once storage was dropped; it's now just a UI/orchestration build on existing endpoints.
